security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU implements MIPU/SIPU bits in mstatus/sstatus with incorrect encoding (unallocated reserved bits) or fails to conditionally trigger automatic stacking on interrupt-taken traps at Machine/Supervisor level based on these bits, or the bits are readable/writable when they should be WARL 0 until encoding is allocated, or mipopret/sipopret execution incorrectly depends on or modifies these bits
security_spec.summary: Unallocated MIPU/SIPU control bits in mstatus/sstatus gate automatic stacking on interrupt traps; incorrect emulation of these bits or their side-effects on trap handling can corrupt the interrupt context save/restore path, enabling privilege escalation within the guest
